original: 私は騒音が原因で眠れない。

en.text: I can't sleep because of the noise.

original: トム、どうしたの？眠れないの？じゃあ、眠れるまで、本読んであげようか？

en.text: What's wrong, Tom? You can't sleep? How about I read you a book?

original: 久しぶりにぐっすり眠れた。

en.text: I got some solid sleep for the first time in a while.

original: 昨夜は、咳き込んで眠れなかった。

en.text: I couldn't sleep last night. I coughed a lot.

original: 痛くて痛くて、眠れなかった。

en.text: The pain was so intense that I couldn't sleep.

original: ほとんどの場合、一晩中眠れずにいた。

en.text: More often than not I lay awake all night.

original: 昨日の夜は、あまり眠れなかったんだ。

en.text: I didn't get much sleep last night.

original: 自分のベッドじゃないと眠れないのよ。

en.text: I can only sleep in my own bed.

original: 眠れないの。どうしたらいい？

en.text: I can't sleep. What should I do?

original: 昨夜はあまり眠れなくてさ、仕事中ずっとうとうとしてた。

en.text: I didn't get much sleep last night so I was nodding off all day at work.

original: 外が明るすぎて眠れない。

en.text: I can't sleep because it's too bright outside.
It's too bright outside to sleep.

original: 皆さんおはようございます。よく眠れましたか？いい夢は見れましたか？

en.text: Good morning, everyone. Have you slept well and had nice dreams?

original: 床にはついたものの、眠れなった。

en.text: I went to bed, but I couldn't fall asleep.

original: よく眠れた。

en.text: I slept well.

original: 明け方2時過ぎまで、眠れなかった。

en.text: I didn't fall asleep until after 2 o'clock in the morning.

original: 昨日は、咳で眠れなかった。

en.text: I was not able to sleep yesterday because I had a cough.
